name: UUNet Australia
summary: Australian operation of UUNet (MCI WorldCom subsidiary; launched AU/NZ 2 Sep 1999); inherited Access One's business services (rebranded UUNet 1999); corporate arm wound down after WorldCom's 2002 bankruptcy (VERIZON AUSTRALIA PTY LIMITED (FORMERLY MCI WORLDCOM AUST PTY LTD), ACN 081 001 194).

events.details: Corporate arm wound down after WorldCom bankruptcy. Both current and proposal converge on c. 2003; verified: AU site redirecting from 2002 and UUNET folded into MCI branding in 2003.

refs.label: Last real UUNET Australia homepage Sep 2001.
Australian site reduced to redirects from Apr 2002.
Jun 2003: UUNET demoted to an MCI wholesale sub-brand after WorldCom collapse - end of UUNET as a distinct provider.
